title: CausalT5K: Diagnosing and Informing Refusal for Trustworthy Causal Reasoning of Skepticism, Sycophancy, Detection-Correction, and Rung Collapse

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance on a dataset (CausalT5K) of narrative scenarios containing specific causal traps (e.g., selection bias, confounding, collider bias, ecological fallacy) versus valid causal designs, utilizing structural causal models and diagnostic rubrics to measure utility (sensitivity) and safety (specificity).

Measuring the 'Bad Flip Rate' by comparing model responses on neutral causal queries versus adversarial pressure variants where a simulated user strongly advocates for a flawed conclusion, evaluating if the model abandons correct reasoning.
